svg.text: Each slice as you see it standing in front of the controller: characters left → right, rows bottom → top.
controller (the block you click to open the machine) (1 cell)
heatproof machine casing (at least 66); hatches go in these cells too: energy hatch ×2, input
bus ×1, input hatch ×1, output bus ×1, output hatch ×1 (72 cells)
A blank cell means any block can go there.
